To lay the context for this story, there was this boy who was always a bit hyper and known to disrupt class, and he absolutely loved everything military. Stories, books, old gear, games... if it was related to the US military, he loved it. One day, in one particular teacher's class, everyone was sitting quiet, doing their work, when this guy leaps up, points out the window, and yells "GOOKS IN THE TREES! TAKE COVER!" and then leaps under a desk. Of course this startles everyone and they sort of freak out in the few seconds it takes to realize just what was going on and that this guy was just being a spaz. Obviously, the teacher was angry that the class was disrupted.

Instead of suspending the kid, or talking him down, this teacher decides to get even...

Fast forward a few days. This teacher is walking down the hallway, and he spots this 'problem' kid in one of the classrooms.
